_comment: Services never enter Effect's error channel (Tim's decision). The program breaks that on purpose, one service per path: Effect.catch of a failure, Effect.catchDefect of a defect, a value thrown in Effect.try, a failure re-raised by Fiber.join, Exit.cause read with Cause.findError, a Cause.map callback's input, and a Context in the failure channel. Reads through the error channel keep nothing, so all their methods are removed and the bundle is not run; the directly read control keeps its method.
